title: Strict henselization preserves local Krull dimension
statement: Let $R$ be a local commutative ring and $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field. Then $\dim R=\dim R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LK (lemma-henselization-dimension), equality of dimensions for R and R^sh

proof.text: The canonical map $R\to R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is a local ring map, faithfully flat by [lem-sc-strict-henselization-faithfully-flat]. Therefore [lem-sc-faithfully-flat-local-dimension] gives $\dim R\le\dim R^{\mathrm{sh}}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LK, proof first sentence using Tag 07QM(1) and Algebra Tag 00OH

proof.text: Write $\mathfrak m$ for the maximal ideal of $R$. By [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples] applied with $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak m$ (so $R_{\mathfrak p}=R$), $R^{\mathrm{sh}}=C=\varinjlim S$ is a filtered colimit over triples $(S,\mathfrak q,\phi)$ with $R\to S$ etale and $\mathfrak q$ over $\mathfrak m$, and $\mathfrak m_C=\ker\psi$ where $\psi|_S$ is $S\to\kappa(\mathfrak q)\to K$; hence the contraction of $\mathfrak m_C$ to $S$ is $\mathfrak q$. Let $\mathfrak Q_0\subsetneq\dots\subsetneq\mathfrak Q_n$ be a chain of primes of $C$. By [lem-sc-filtered-colimit-prime-chain-dimension] there is a stage $(S,\mathfrak q,\phi)$ in which the contractions form a strictly increasing chain; all of them lie in the contraction $\mathfrak q$ of $\mathfrak m_C\supseteq\mathfrak Q_n$, so they give a chain of length $n$ in $S_{\mathfrak q}$ and $n\le\dim S_{\mathfrak q}$. By [lem-sc-etale-local-dimension] applied to $R\to S$ and $\mathfrak q$ (lying over $\mathfrak m$), $\dim S_{\mathfrak q}=\dim R_{\mathfrak m}=\dim R$. Hence $n\le\dim R$ for every chain, so $\dim R^{\mathrm{sh}}\le\dim R$.
